The '''30th Producers Guild of America Awards''' (also known as '''2019 Producers Guild Awards'''), honoring the best [[Film producer|film]] and [[television producer]]s of 2018, were held at [[The Beverly Hilton]] in [[Beverly Hills, California]] on January 19, 2019.<ref>{{cite news |title=Producers Guild Awards: 'Green Book' Named Outstanding Motion Picture
